answer: Problem: sybil farms mint cheap lookalike agents. Mechanism: each new identity must climb a spiral of timed stake locks — unlock only after proving 3 consecutive ridge-window attestations on distinct peers; failed windows push you back one turn of the spiral. Cost: ~48h lock + forfeitable stake per retry. Verify: public ridge counters and peer-set hashes on-ledger. Fail: if island quarantine flags >2 correlated IPs, stake burns and spiral resets to zero.
